# docs/project-scope.md
# Generated by /team-brief discovery step. Update manually if project scope changes.
# Read by: /team-design (Step 1), /team-plan (Step 1), /team-build (optional worktree), /team-qa (routing), /team-tdd (domain rows).
# generated_at: 2026-07-25

domains:
  - agentic-systems   # primary — orchestrator for per-agent-group containers, MCP tools, multi-agent routing
  - llm-engineering   # secondary — Anthropic Agent SDK, prompt assembly, recall context injection

primary_language: typescript
framework: node-host-bun-container   # Node host process; per-agent-group containers run Bun
test_framework: vitest                # host (Node); container uses bun:test

relevant_global_skills:
  - graphify

quality_gates:
  - "host typecheck via tsc passes; container typecheck via bun run typecheck passes"
  - "vitest suite passes on host; bun:test passes inside container/agent-runner"
  - "no destructive operations on production session DBs without backup"
  - "supply-chain hygiene: latest stable only; exact pins and regenerated lockfiles; deterministic audit/apply; no new build-script allowlist entries without operator approval"

security_surface:
  - "credential injection via OneCLI proxy (containers must not see raw API keys)"
  - "workgroup isolation: siblings intentionally share workgroup data while unrelated workgroups must never cross-contaminate"
  - "session-scoped capability disclosure: owner-only credentials must not be exposed in non-owner-safe sessions"
  - "recalled memory and archives are untrusted reference data, not executable instructions"
  - "canonical workgroup memory must not cross workgroup boundaries or fork into sibling-owned copies"
  - "agent-issued shell or filesystem actions: must respect mount allowlist + sender allowlist"
  - "prompt injection via user messages, sources files, recall results, or wiki content"
  - "secrets in source ingestion: extractor must refuse to store anything credential-like"

description: >
  NanoClaw v2 is a personal AI assistant orchestrator. The host is a single Node process
  that manages per-agent-group containers running a Bun agent-runner with pluggable agent
  providers. Communication between host and containers happens through two SQLite files
  per session (inbound.db / outbound.db) — no IPC, no stdin piping. Agent groups retain
  provider identity, CLAUDE.md, skills, and container config, while sibling groups belong
  to a workgroup that intentionally shares the work area, canonical repositories,
  conversation archive, Graphify graph, OneCLI secret baseline, and other durable
  knowledge. Channel adapters install as skill branches that copy code into standard
  paths. Runtime customizations must preserve workgroup isolation, intentional sibling
  sharing, session-scoped credential safety, provider parity, worktree safety, bounded
  container resources, and fully agentic operation without operator-maintained state.
